attack_types.name: Brute Force Authentication
attack_types.description: Repeated login attempts using dictionary or password guessing.

attack_types.name: Credential Stuffing
attack_types.description: Automated login attempts using leaked credential pairs.

attack_types.name: SQL Injection (SQLi)
attack_types.description: Malicious SQL syntax injected into input fields or URL parameters.

attack_types.name: Path / Directory Traversal
attack_types.description: Attempts to access files outside the intended root directory (e.g. ../../../etc/passwd).

attack_types.name: Vulnerability / Port Scanning
attack_types.description: Automated probing of endpoints, admin interfaces, and common sensitive files.

attack_types.name: Privilege Escalation
attack_types.description: Attempts to elevate session permissions or bypass role checks.

attack_types.name: Command Injection (RCE)
attack_types.description: Injection of shell or OS command sequences in input parameters.

attack_types.name: Data Exfiltration Probe
attack_types.description: Attempts to download fake confidential honey-tokens, database dumps, or keys.
